race.comment: AMBELLO (1) does not win often, but is creeping closer after being beaten by a nose at Coleraine just over 3 weeks ago. He drops down further in class, and should just about go one better. NICKING GRACIE (7) will be peaking third up from a spell, and dons the blinkers for the first time for this marginally easier assignment. She benefits from a 1.5kg claim, and she has a good chance to break her win drought in this. ARABIAN MYTH (2) resumes from a spell at an easier level, and a recent jump-out will ensure that he can be competitive fresh up in this. Check the markets. DANERICH DAN (3) will have no fitness concerns fourth up from a spell, and this veteran has his best chance in a while to show some worthwhile form again. Include. GRUMPYOLDCOL (6) had a tough trip last time out at Donald, and he will be hoping for some better luck here, albeit from another wide draw. Include in all combos.
